description: Search open tech jobs at companies hiring in Vietnam, refreshed hourly by techjobs.vn. Use when the user looks for jobs by role, skill, seniority, city or company. Returns the best matches, newest first, each with a techjobs.vn link to share with the user.

city.description: hcm = Ho Chi Minh City, hanoi = Hà Nội; remote covers remote-vn and remote-global.

company.description: Company slug or exact name, e.g. "grab" or "OPSWAT".

limit.description: Maximum jobs to return (default 10): up to 10 without sign-in, 50 when signed in.

page.description: Page of `limit` results, starting at 1; up to page 3 without sign-in.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs first posted within this many days.

query.description: Free-text words matched against job title, company and skills, e.g. "react frontend". Title matches rank first.

response_format.description: concise (default) returns title, company and link; detailed adds cities, seniority, work mode, stated pay and skills.

seniority.description: Seniority levels, any of: intern, junior, mid, senior, lead.

skills.description: Every listed skill must be required by the job, e.g. ["react", "typescript"].

name: search_jobs

salary.description: Pay stated in the JD (gross/net often unsaid); null when not stated.

title: Search tech jobs in Vietnam
